outputs.L1: A digital broadcast receiving apparatus capable of executing a function with higher added value may include: a broadcast receiving unit configured to receive, from a broadcast transmission path, broadcasting data of broadcast program content and location information in which a reference destination for obtaining data related to the broadcasting data is described; a communication unit configured to receive, via a communication line, communication data of the program content from the reference destination described in the location information; a recording/reproducing unit configured to record and reproduce the broadcasting data of the broadcast program content received by the broadcast receiving unit; an outputting unit configured to output, to external equipment, the broadcasting data of the broadcast program content reproduced from the recording/reproducing unit; and a server function unit for the external equipment. The outputting unit may be configured to output the location information together with the reproduced broadcasting data.
outputs.L2: A digital broadcast reception device designed to provide enhanced functionality may include several components. These include a broadcast receiver that receives broadcast data for broadcast program content, along with location information, through a broadcast transmission route. The location information identifies a reference destination from which data associated with the broadcast data can be acquired. The device may also include a communication section that obtains communication data for the program content from the reference destination indicated by the location information via a communication line. In addition, it may have a recording and playback section that records and plays back the broadcast program content data received by the broadcast receiver, an output section that sends the reproduced broadcast program content data from the recording and playback section to external equipment, and a server function section for use with external equipment. The output section may be configured to operate in a mode in which the location information is provided together with the reproduced broadcast data.
outputs.L3:
The apparatus is configured to receive broadcasting data corresponding to program content, together with location information associated with that broadcasting data, through a broadcast transmission path. The program content may include, for example, video, audio, text, or other data distributed as part of a broadcast service.

The location information includes information indicating a reference destination from which data related to the received broadcasting data can be obtained. This reference destination may be, for example, an address or identifier such as a URL, server address, or other access information that enables additional or related data to be acquired through a communication network.

In addition to receiving the broadcasting data through the broadcast transmission path, the apparatus is capable of receiving communication data related to the same program content from the reference destination indicated by the location information. This communication data is obtained through a communication line, such as an Internet connection or another network communication path. As a result, the apparatus can supplement the broadcast program content with related data acquired from an external source.

The apparatus further includes a recording and reproducing unit. This unit is capable of recording and storing the received broadcasting data, and subsequently reproducing or playing back the stored broadcasting data when required. Through this function, broadcast content received at one time can be preserved and later viewed or otherwise used by a user.

Moreover, when the recorded broadcasting data is reproduced, the apparatus can output the reproduced broadcasting data together with the corresponding location information to external equipment. The external equipment may then use the location information to access related communication data from the indicated reference destination. The apparatus is also capable of functioning as a server for the external equipment, thereby providing the external equipment with access to reproduced broadcasting data and associated information. In this way, the apparatus supports both local recording and playback of broadcast content and distribution or provision of that content and related access information to other devices.
outputs.L4:
A digital broadcast receiving apparatus is provided for enhancing the functionality and value of broadcast programs by linking broadcast content with communication-based services. The apparatus receives digital broadcast data that includes broadcast program content and associated location information, such as information indicating a server address, network location, or other access destination related to the broadcast program. Using this location information, the apparatus can obtain communication data associated with the received broadcast program through a communication network.

The apparatus includes a broadcast receiving function for receiving and demodulating digital broadcast signals, a recording function for storing received broadcast data, and a reproducing function for playing back recorded broadcast content. When broadcast data containing location information is received, the apparatus extracts the location information and uses it to access external communication equipment, such as a server connected to the Internet or another communication network. By doing so, the apparatus can acquire additional data related to the broadcast program, including supplementary information, interactive content, updated program data, advertising information, purchase information, or other linked service data.

The apparatus may record both the broadcast program data and the corresponding location information. During reproduction of the recorded broadcast program, the apparatus can reproduce the broadcast data while also making the associated location information available. As a result, even when the program is viewed after recording, the user or connected equipment can access communication data related to the reproduced program. This allows linked services to remain available not only during real-time viewing but also during later playback.

The apparatus is also capable of outputting reproduced broadcast data together with the associated location information to external equipment. For example, the apparatus may provide the reproduced broadcast content and the extracted or stored location information to another device that has communication capabilities. The external equipment may then use the location information to access a server or other network resource and obtain communication data related to the reproduced broadcast content. In this manner, the broadcast receiving apparatus can cooperate with external communication devices to provide expanded services without requiring all communication functions to be incorporated into the broadcast receiver itself.

By combining digital broadcast reception, recording and reproduction of broadcast content, extraction and use of location information, and linkage with communication data obtained from servers or other network resources, the apparatus enables higher-value broadcast services. Users can receive additional information and interactive services associated with broadcast programs, and service providers can offer program-linked content, advertisements, transactions, or other enhanced services. The apparatus therefore improves the usability and commercial value of digital broadcasting by integrating broadcast functions with communication and server-based functions.
outputs.L5:
**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the smallest and most common words in the English language, yet it plays an important role in how we communicate. It is known as the definite article, used to point to a specific person, place, thing, or idea. When we say “the book,” we are not talking about just any book—we mean a particular one.

Although “the” is simple, it helps give sentences clarity and precision. It can make language feel more focused and direct. For example, “a car” could mean any car, but “the car” refers to one that both the speaker and listener understand.

This tiny word appears everywhere: in stories, conversations, news articles, songs, and speeches. It connects ideas, guides meaning, and helps readers know exactly what is being discussed. Without “the,” English would feel less natural and often less clear.

In short, “the” may be small, but it is essential. It proves that even the simplest words can have a powerful effect on language.

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a patent-style abstract for a digital broadcast receiver that receives broadcast program data and location information, obtains related content via a communication network, records/reproduces broadcasts, outputs them to external equipment, and includes a server function.
counterfactuals.output: A digital broadcast receiver includes a broadcast receiving unit configured to receive digital broadcast signals including program data and location-related information, a communication interface configured to access a communication network, a control unit configured to acquire, via the communication network, content related to a received broadcast program based on the location-related information or program information, and a storage unit configured to record the received broadcast program and/or the acquired related content. The receiver further includes a reproduction unit configured to reproduce recorded broadcast data and related content, an output interface configured to output the received or reproduced data to external equipment, and a server function configured to provide stored broadcast data, acquired related content, program information, or location-related information to another apparatus through the communication network. Accordingly, broadcast programs and network-acquired related content can be integrally received, stored, reproduced, output, and distributed to external equipment or network-connected devices.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate an invention summary for a digital broadcast receiving device capable of higher added-value functions, including broadcast reception, communication-based content retrieval, recording/reproduction, external output, and server functionality.
counterfactuals.output:
## Invention Summary

The invention relates to a digital broadcast receiving device configured to provide higher added-value functions by combining digital broadcast reception with network communication, content recording/reproduction, external output, and server functionality.

The digital broadcast receiving device includes a broadcast receiving unit that receives digital broadcast signals and extracts broadcast content and related broadcast information. The device further includes a communication unit connected to a network, such as the Internet or a home network, for acquiring additional content, metadata, application data, update information, or related services associated with the received broadcast program.

A control unit manages cooperation between broadcast reception and communication-based content retrieval. For example, when a user selects a broadcast program, the device may automatically or selectively acquire related information, extended program content, subtitles, language data, advertisements, interactive content, or downloadable media from an external server through the communication unit. As a result, the device can provide enhanced services beyond conventional broadcast viewing.

The device also includes a storage unit for recording received broadcast content, communication-acquired content, or a combination thereof. A reproduction unit reproduces recorded content under control of the control unit. The storage unit may also store program guide information, user preference information, viewing history, authentication information, and content management information.

An external output interface outputs received, retrieved, recorded, or reproduced content to an external apparatus, such as a television, display, audio device, recording apparatus, portable terminal, or home network device. The external output may include digital video/audio output, analog output, network streaming output, or data output.

The digital broadcast receiving device further includes server functionality. The server function allows the device to provide stored or received content, program information, or related data to another device connected via a network. For example, the device may operate as a home media server that streams recorded broadcast programs to client devices, supplies program metadata, or enables remote browsing and playback control. The server function may also permit remote reservation of recording, remote content search, or remote access to recorded content, subject to authentication and access control.

Accordingly, the digital broadcast receiving device is capable of receiving digital broadcasts, acquiring additional content through communication, recording and reproducing content, outputting content to external devices, and functioning as a content server. This integrated configuration enables enhanced user convenience and provides higher added-value services compared with a conventional digital broadcast receiver limited to broadcast reception alone.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3
